component.name: GeoBiz Uzbekistan
component.summary: District wellbeing, safety, ecology and business potential on Google Maps

description.p: GeoBiz Uzbekistan visualises the wellbeing, safety, ecology and business potential of Uzbekistan's territories — regions, cities, districts and mahallas — directly on a real Google Maps layer. Territories are coloured into transparent zones (green, purple, blue, gray, yellow, orange, red) and a built-in offline assistant answers business questions such as where to open a coffee shop or which districts are safest.
The app never fabricates data: territories without sufficient information are clearly marked "Недостаточно данных" and are left uncoloured.
First release: Google Maps integration, colour zones, district details, and the local AI assistant.
